Name: Hodiah
Summary: Wife of Mered, sister of Naham, named in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:19: Wife of Mered, sister of Naham, named in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Hodiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
